policy.name: HARBORVIEW COMMERCIAL LENDING POLICY Credit Policy CP-2026

rules.name: Exposure limit
rules.description: The principal of any single facility must not exceed USD 50,000,000.
rules.source_quote: The principal of any single facility must not exceed USD 50,000,000.

rules.name: Loan-to-value
rules.description: The loan-to-value ratio must not exceed 75%, measured against an independent collateral valuation.
rules.source_quote: The loan-to-value ratio must not exceed 75%, measured against an independent collateral valuation.

rules.name: Independent valuation
rules.description: Collateral must be described and supported by a dated valuation from an independent appraiser.
rules.source_quote: Collateral must be described and supported by a dated valuation from an independent appraiser; a borrower estimate or a valuation still to be delivered is not acceptable.

rules.name: Tenor
rules.description: The final maturity date must be no more than 7 years after the effective date.
rules.source_quote: The final maturity date must be no more than 7 years after the effective date.

rules.name: Guarantee
rules.description: Facilities above USD 10,000,000 require a parent or third-party guarantee.
rules.source_quote: Facilities above USD 10,000,000 require a parent or third-party guarantee.

rules.name: Pricing
rules.description: The interest rate must be fully defined as a numeric fixed rate or a named benchmark plus a numeric margin.
rules.source_quote: The interest rate must be fully defined, either as a numeric fixed rate or as a named benchmark plus a numeric margin.

rules.name: Debt service coverage
rules.description: The agreement must include a debt service coverage ratio covenant of at least 1.25x.
rules.source_quote: The agreement must include a debt service coverage ratio covenant of at least 1.25x.

rules.name: Audited accounts
rules.description: Audited annual financial statements must be delivered within 120 days of the financial year end.
rules.source_quote: Audited annual financial statements must be delivered within 120 days of the financial year end.

rules.name: Events of default
rules.description: Events of default must include payment default, cross-default, and insolvency.
rules.source_quote: The events of default must include payment default, cross-default and insolvency.

rules.name: Governing law
rules.description: The agreement must state a governing law and a forum for disputes.
rules.source_quote: The agreement must state a governing law and a forum for disputes.

rules.name: Prepayment
rules.description: Voluntary and mandatory prepayment terms must be specified.
rules.source_quote: Voluntary and mandatory prepayment terms must be specified.

rules.name: Key dates
rules.description: Effective date, first repayment date, and maturity date must be stated consistently.
rules.source_quote: The effective date, first repayment date and maturity date must be stated consistently wherever they appear.

rules.name: Use of proceeds
rules.description: The agreement must state the purpose of the loan and restrict prohibited uses of proceeds.
rules.source_quote: The agreement must state the purpose of the loan and restrict prohibited uses of the proceeds.
